_note: Deliberately broken versions of daily_check.py, as one exact find→replace each. break_attempts.py builds each mutant in a temporary copy (the real file is never edited), runs the offline suite against it, and requires the suite to FAIL. A mutant the suite does not catch means the tests cannot see that bug.
